Sprint 4 design spec for InkOS — Dodo Payments billing layer. Working dir: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS`. Continue exact design language from Sprints 1-3 (dark theme, electric-purple, tabular-nums, skeletons, base-nova render not asChild, CSS group-data for sidebar, 4px grid).

**Sprint 4 scope to design:**

1. **Billing & Plan page** at `/settings/billing` — THE billing hub. Sections top-to-bottom:
   - **Current plan card** — plan tier + cycle + price with `tabular-nums`, next renewal date, trial badge if in trial with days-remaining, status pill (active/past_due/trialing/canceled with color). "Change plan" + "Cancel subscription" secondary actions. If past_due → prominent amber alert with "Update payment method" CTA.
   - **Plan selector** — 4 pricing cards (Solo $29 / Studio $59 / Pro $99 / Enterprise $199) side-by-side on desktop, stack on mobile. Monthly/Annual toggle (toggle shows "Save 20%" badge on annual). Current plan highlighted. Feature checklist per card pulled from `plans.features` jsonb. Upgrade CTA → Dodo hosted checkout redirect. Downgrade → confirmation modal warning about feature loss at period end.
   - **Usage meters** — 4 progress bars: artists used / max, locations used / max, SMS sent this period / quota, AI generations used / quota. Color: green 0-60%, amber 60-85%, red 85%+. "Add capacity" link on near-full meters.
   - **Invoice history table** — columns: date, invoice # (dodo_invoice_id), description (plan + period), amount, status pill, download PDF action, view hosted URL action. Last 25 + "Load more" pagination.
   - **Payment method** card — current card brand + last4 + exp, "Update" CTA → Dodo customer portal redirect.
   - **Cancel flow** — clicking "Cancel subscription" opens confirmation modal: "You'll keep access until [current_period_end]. Your data will be preserved." Confirm button then secondary "Never mind" — cancellation sets `cancel_at_period_end=true` not instant.

2. **Upgrade prompt component** (`components/billing/UpgradeGate.tsx`) — Reusable inline prompt shown whenever user hits a feature gate. Props: feature name, required plan, benefits list. "Upgrade to Pro" CTA. Used in: AI design page (Sprint 9), payroll (Sprint 8), multi-location (Sprint 11), commission splits for solo tier (Sprint 7), guest artist module (Sprint 10). Must be dismissible but respawns on next gate trigger.

3. **Quota-exceeded banner** — Top-of-page banner when a meter hits quota (e.g. SMS quota hit → "You've used all 1,000 SMS this month. Buy add-on credits or upgrade"). Sticky until dismissed or quota reset.

4. **Deposit collection UX** (wire up Sprint 2 placeholder button):
   - **In internal new-appointment drawer**: "Require deposit" toggle + deposit amount (defaults from service). If on, booking creates as `status='pending'` with deposit pending.
   - **In public booking flow** (`/book/[studioSlug]/[serviceId]`): if `services.deposit_required` or `booking_page_settings.require_deposit_on_public`, show deposit amount + "Continue to deposit" CTA. Clicking redirects to Dodo hosted checkout with `success_url` → confirmation page, `cancel_url` → back to slot picker.
   - **Post-checkout confirmation**: polls `/api/public/bookings/[token]` until `deposit_paid=true` (Dodo webhook flips it). Shows spinner with "Confirming your payment..." for up to 10s. Falls back to "Deposit received" banner once flipped.
   - **Internal appointment detail** (`/appointments/[id]`): deposit status pill (paid/pending/failed), receipt URL link, "Collect balance" CTA on `completed` status → Dodo checkout for (price − deposit + tip).

5. **Refund workflow UI** — On cancelled appointments with paid deposit: "Refund deposit" button (owner/admin only). Opens modal: amount (editable, defaults to deposit_cents), reason (textarea), confirm → creates `refund_requests` row, triggers Dodo refund via API. Shows refund status timeline.

6. **Admin billing view** at `/admin/billing` (platform admin only) — Platform-level:
   - MRR card, ARR, churn rate, trial conversion % (stub shape Sprint 12 builds charts)
   - Subscription list: studio, plan, status, MRR contribution, next renewal, actions (view, cancel)
   - Dodo webhook log: last 50 events with retry counts + error details
   - Failed payment list + actions

7. **Trial onboarding banner** — First-login banner after signup: "14-day free trial — $0 until [trial_end]. Add a payment method to continue after." Dismissable. Persists until payment method attached.

8. **Feature gate patterns** (shown across app via `UpgradeGate`):
   - Sidebar nav items for gated features show a lock icon + "Pro" chip
   - Clicking locked item doesn't navigate — opens upgrade modal
   - Inline gates on feature pages (e.g. AI design page body replaced by gate)

**Dodo integration UX principles:**
- Never build a card form — always redirect to Dodo hosted checkout
- Customer portal button → fetches portal URL from API → `window.location.href`
- Every payment action has loading → success → error states
- Failed payments show inline card error banner with retry CTA
- All money displayed via `formatCurrency` (cents → $X.XX)
- Currency-aware (default USD; show currency code on invoices)

**Hard rules (locked from Sprints 1-3):**
- `text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight` page titles
- `tabular-nums` on all prices, amounts, quota numbers
- Dark-first, ink-black bg, electric-purple primary
- Skeletons match real layout, never spinners
- Every data component ships loading/empty/error/success
- base-nova: `render` not `asChild`
- CSS `group-data-[collapsible=icon]:*` for sidebar
- 4px grid, max 3 font sizes per page, 150ms ease-out animations
- `animationFillMode: "both"` on staggered lists
- Money in cents, display via `formatCurrency`
- No raw hex outside brand swatch

**Deliverables — write to `.handoffs/sprint-4-design-spec.md`:**
1. `/settings/billing` page layout with sections + Tailwind classes
2. Plan selector component spec with annual/monthly toggle
3. Usage meter component (reusable — also lands on dashboard)
4. Invoice table row + detail drawer
5. `UpgradeGate` component full spec (props, variants: inline / page-block / modal)
6. Deposit flow sequence diagram (internal drawer → public booking → Dodo → webhook → confirmation)
7. "Collect balance" CTA pattern on appointment detail
8. Refund modal design
9. Admin billing page wireframe
10. Trial banner + payment-method prompt states
11. Feature gate visual patterns (sidebar lock, inline block, modal)
12. Empty states (no invoices, no payment method yet)
13. Toast templates (plan changed, card updated, deposit collected, refund processed, payment failed)
14. Component inventory with paths
15. Build sequence for Koda (linear 12-14 items with acceptance criteria)

Keep it actionable — Koda builds directly from it.

180	- **Context:** I wrote a Rankora migration plan specifying "Next.js 14 App Router" throughout, without checking the npm registry. Yash asked "why we using next js 14? there already latest version available right?" I ran `npm view next version` → **16.2.3** was the actual latest. Next 15 shipped Oct 2024. 181	- **Rule:** Before recommending or using a specific version of ANY framework, library, or major dependency in a plan or implementation, ALWAYS run `npm view <pkg> version` AND `npm view <pkg> dist-tags` to verify the actual current stable. Cite the output in the plan. Do NOT default to versions from training data.
182	- **Why:** This directly violates the CLAUDE.md rule "Latest stable versions always — no legacy patterns, no deprecated APIs." Plans with wrong versions cascade: wrong breaking changes, wrong peer deps, wrong docs, wasted research, lost credibility.
183	- **How to apply:**
184	  1. Any time a plan or code mentions a version number for Next.js, React, Node, Supabase, Prisma, Shopify CLI/Polaris, Tailwind, Vite, AI SDKs, etc. → run `npm view <pkg> version` FIRST.
185	  2. For peer compatibility, run `npm view <pkg> peerDependencies` on every major dep before locking.
186	  3. Same applies to other ecosystems: `pip index versions <pkg>`, `cargo search <pkg>`, `gem list <pkg> --remote --exact`, `go list -m -versions <mod>`.
187	  4. If you cannot verify (no network, offline), say so **explicitly** instead of guessing: "Could not verify latest — assuming X, verify before install."
188	  5. When stating a version, include the source: "Next.js 16.2.3 (confirmed via `npm view next version` on 2026-04-10)."
189	- **Applies to:** ALL agents — Arya (architecture), Riko (scaffold), Koda (build), Rex (orchestration), Nova (research). Especially critical for any plan that specifies a scaffold command or `package.json` content.

Stack B (Shopify) uses Shopify Billing API — never Dodo, never Stripe.

1	
2	**From:** Vega (Design Agent)
3	**To:** Koda (Feature Builder)
4	**Date:** 2026-04-15

10	## 0. Pre-Build Rules (Koda reads this before line 1)
11	
12	Carry all 10 rules from Sprint 1 spec forward. New Sprint 2 additions:
13	
14	11. Calendar library: **FullCalendar React** (`@fullcalendar/react` + `@fullcalendar/daygrid` + `@fullcalendar/timegrid` + `@fullcalendar/interaction`). See Section 1 for decision record.
15	12. Calendar drag-drop uses FullCalendar's `eventDrop` + `eventResize` callbacks. Update optimistically; roll back on API error with `toast.error`.
16	13. Appointment drawer is a `Sheet` (slide-in right), NOT a Dialog. It covers ~40% of the viewport at `xl`, full-width on mobile.
17	14. Public booking flow (`/book/[studioSlug]/**`) has zero InkOS chrome — no sidebar, no AppHeader. Isolated layout.
18	15. Public booking pages never import from `lib/supabase/server.ts` — only `lib/supabase/client.ts` or server actions using the service role for slot availability reads.
19	16. Status transitions are unidirectional (see Section 6). Never render a transition button that would create an illegal state.
20	17. `tabular-nums` class is mandatory on all time displays, date displays, and money values.
21	18. Appointment detail photo gallery: images fetched as Supabase signed URLs — never expose the raw storage path to the client.
22	19. New appointment drawer steps are wizard-scoped — use a local step state machine, NOT the URL (opening this drawer must not change the route).
23	20. Dodo deposit button in public booking is a `<button>` placeholder with `data-testid="deposit-cta"` — Sprint 4 wires the real checkout. Do NOT stub a fake form.
24	
25	---
26	
27	## 1. Calendar Library Decision Record
28	
29	### Candidates evaluated
30	
31	| Library | Bundle (gzipped) | Drag-drop | Time grid | TS support | License | Verdict |
32	|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
33	| **FullCalendar React** | ~58 KB | Native, polished | Yes (15/30/60 min slots) | Excellent | MIT (core) | **PICK** |
34	| react-big-calendar | ~32 KB | Via react-dnd | Yes | Adequate | MIT | Runner-up |
35	| Schedule-X | ~28 KB | Beta only | Yes | Good | MIT | Too new |
36	| Custom | ~0 KB | Manual | Manual | Perfect | — | Too costly |
37	
38	### Why FullCalendar
39	
40	1. **Drag-drop is production-grade** out of box — handles collision feedback, ghost preview, snap-to-slot. react-big-calendar requires manual react-dnd integration and has no snap.
41	2. **Time grid is the main view** for daily studio ops. FullCalendar's `timeGridDay` and `timeGridWeek` are the industry reference; react-big-calendar's time grid is notoriously buggy with overlapping events.
42	3. **`eventOverlap` callback** lets us prevent double-booking client-side before the API round-trip.
43	4. **Theming:** FullCalendar exposes CSS variables for every color, border, and background — maps cleanly to our `oklch` tokens. No hacking inline styles.
44	5. **Tested at scale:** Porter (our top competitor) uses it. We beat their UX by theming it to our dark system and adding the artist-color palette.

49	pnpm add @fullcalendar/react @fullcalendar/core @fullcalendar/daygrid \

- Zero card forms anywhere — all checkout/portal actions are `window.location.href` redirects

**UpgradeGate is 3 variants, not 1:** `inline` for partial page sections, `page-block` for fully gated pages, `modal` for sidebar nav clicks. The `useUpgradeModal` hook lets any component trigger the modal variant without prop drilling.
